T-3 + T-5: the plant contract-table harness with ZERO cases. Clone contract.test.js's harness (driveHandler/postHandlerOf, committedIds, committableCollects, store reset) but composing the PLANT set. CRITICAL — test/setup-obligation-set.js (global vitest setupFiles) pre-configures the live-animals set for every test file, so this file must reconfigure in beforeAll: configureObligationSet(namespace import of ./sets/plant-products/obligations/index.js), configureFulfilmentRegistry(featureEvaluationBindings from ./sets/plant-products/journeys/linear/features/evaluation.js), configureJourneyFlow({sections, taskRows, rowStatus, nextRunTarget, flowOnlyKeys: FLOW_ONLY_KEYS, entryGuardTarget, layout: LAYOUT} from the plant flow/config modules), buildDispatch(dispatchPages from ./sets/plant-products/journeys/linear/features/index.js), configureRecords(the in-memory stub impl from ./sets/plant-products/services/records/stub.js — use whatever export name pp-007 landed), configureSession(sessionStub from ./services/persistence/session/stub.js). Do NOT call configureCommodityReference (FD-5 — the L2 commodity-reference singleton is live-animals mapper machinery, inert on the plant path). Do NOT compute anything set-derived at module load (live contract.test.js line 43 computes obligationNames at module scope — that pattern would read the live-animals set from the global setup; compute inside beforeAll/tests only). Content: `const cases = []` with the T-5 standing-rule comment ('every collecting plant controller adds its valid-POST case here — the table is manual; an unlisted controller is invisible'), plus ONE completeness-guard test: derive the collecting controllers from the plant dispatchPages (entries whose meta.collects, filtered by committableCollects, is non-empty) and assert each has a case in the table — vacuously green at m0 (import-type/dashboard/hub all collect []), bites at pp-018 when the first collecting controller lands without a case. Skip the it.each(cases) runner while cases is empty OR guard it behind cases.length (vitest fails on it.each([])).

notes: GROUPING per the plan's own hint (§9 rule 1-2): P-4 and P-5/T-1..T-3/T-5 are small config/clone edits verified by the same commands and individually too thin to be increments; they must land before the first obligation-bearing page (pp-018) so the cloned contract table and convention rails exist when the first plant obligation registers. First verification command is the BASELINE guard — run test:live-animals BEFORE editing; red baseline = stop and report. LOAD-BEARING DISCOVERY (verified live this session): vitest.config.js setupFiles runs test/setup-obligation-set.js before EVERY test file, pre-configuring the live-animals set into the single-slot singletons (configureObligationSet, configureFulfilmentRegistry, configureCommodityReference, configureJourneyFlow). The FD-10 clone strategy works because Vitest isolates files into workers and configure* are last-write-wins assignments — but every plant clone MUST (a) reconfigure the relevant singletons in its own beforeAll with the plant modules, and (b) never compute set-derived values at module load (the live contract.test.js computes obligationNames at module scope, which under the global setup would silently read the LIVE-ANIMALS manifest — a cloned copy of that line is the most likely silent defect in this increment). Clones do not call configureCommodityReference: FD-5 rules it a live-animals-mapper-only seam and the global setup's live-animals value is inert on the plant path. DECISION — one-load-per-request.test.js is NOT cloned (P-5's 'clone IF it composes a set at runtime — cloner verifies' resolves to no): verified live, it network-mocks the L2 REAL records adapter (services/persistence/records/real/index.js) against /fulfilments|/notifications|/proposed-notifications — live-animals-only machinery the plant path never executes (FD-5/P-2); the plant analogue (GET/PUT counts against /plant-products/notifications for the set-owned real.js) belongs to pp-008's adapter/mapper tests, not an app-root clone. DECISION — the contract clone adds a completeness-guard test (derive collecting controllers from dispatchPages, assert each has a case): this mechanises T-5's standing rule instead of relying on discipline alone, and is the minimal way to keep an it.each table green at zero cases (vitest rejects it.each([])); the live-animals table is deliberately left as-is (no retrofit — mirror-not-gold-plate applies to the existing set). DECISION — IDENTICAL_ALLOWLIST re-keyed with a set prefix so a live-animals justification can never silently exempt a same-named plant feature. DEP NOTE: pp-010 formally depends only on pp-007, which transitively guarantees pp-006's routes-live-animals.js/routes-plant-products.js exist — the P-4 pathNot targets are real files when this runs. Exemplars: src/server/app/{contract,routes,indexed,store-ops,copy-convention,copy-parity}.test.js (all read this session), test/setup-obligation-set.js, .dependency-cruiser.cjs lines 24-34 (routes-is-the-gateway) and 73-85 (sets-not-l1), package.json lines 27-36. The plant verification ladder substitution (test:plant-products for test:live-animals) applies to every subsequent plant increment per §7; this increment ships the script that makes it possible.
